    Local representation-finiteness for finite functor modules #

    The manuscript's local representation-finiteness condition is recorded without choosing a global skeleton: at each object of the base category, a finite family represents every indecomposable module nonzero there. Finite support turns these pointwise families into a finite target Hom neighborhood for any fixed module.
